Kill [[the Black Beast of Arrgh]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill the Black Beast of Arrgh in [[the Foundry of Failed Creations]]
* *BONUS* Kill the Black Beast of Arrgh in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* 750 [[Lightbringer Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 60 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Foundry Breakout]] quest.
